description: Structured behavioral cases for the portal agent. Unlike real-questions-seed.json (bare question strings graded on the global rubric), each case here carries the LIVE PORTAL STATE the agent would actually have at that moment, plus its own pass/fail criteria. Some behaviours only exist in context: an agent with no rates and no accessorials on file cannot reproduce a claim about a carrier refusing one.

cases.why: Live bug: the agent said "JTS doesn't support the appointment accessorial on this lane" while the payload correctly carried APT and appointmentNeeded:true. Nothing in the rate data says which accessorials a carrier will take — the rejection was invented. Guards the prompt fix, which no static check can cover.

messages.content: everything looks right, just book it

must_not: state, imply or hint that JTS Express (or any carrier) rejects, does not support, will not take, or cannot add the appointment accessorial
name a carrier as the reason any accessorial is a problem
claim an accessorial had to be removed, was dropped, or is unavailable on this lane
invent any carrier-specific restriction that the state block does not contain
must: either proceed with the booking as quoted, or ask a legitimate outstanding question (for example a missing contact or pickup window)

cases.why: Contrast case, so the rule above is not over-corrected into never mentioning a real rejection. When a booking call genuinely returns an accessorial error, the agent must report it — silence here would be its own dishonesty.
must: tell the customer the booking did not go through
report the reason the system actually returned — that the appointment accessorial was not accepted
offer a way forward, such as removing the appointment and trying again
must_not: say the shipment was booked or saved
invent a different reason than the one the error gave
